lastCompletedGameRecap.recapHeadline: Jonah Coleman powers Broncos past Raiders 38-24 as Denver honors the late Tom Jackson
lastCompletedGameRecap.recapLeadExcerpt: DENVER -- — Forty years after his retirement from football and 48 hours after his death at age 75, the Denver Broncos set aside a game ball for Tom Jackson in the aftermath of their 38-24 win Sunday over the Las Vegas Raiders .  “I'd be remiss if we didn't start just by honoring Tom Jackson tonight,” Broncos coach Sean Payton said as he began his postgame news conference.  “He got a game ball tonight, his family.  He was part of the rich history, obviously. Even though Mendoza has been sacked 11 times in two games — the same number of times Kirk Cousins was sacked in nine games before his deadline trade to Minnesota — Payton said he sees a potential Raiders resurgence led by Mendoza.
lastCompletedGameRecap.upNextNotes: Up next Raiders: Visit the Cleveland Browns next Sunday. Broncos: Visit the Pittsburgh Steelers on Friday.

injuryReport.name: Denzel Boston
factors: Questionable tag adjusted by player career prior (76%)
injuryReport.beatComment: Per Oyefusi, the Browns are holding a typical Thursday practice Wednesday, and will then have a short walkthrough on Thanksgiving day. Prior to a Week 11 bye, Boston logged 'DNPs' in the team's Wednesday and Thursday practices before being limited to close out his prep for Week 10 action. Though the WR approached Cleveland's 27-24 overtime win over the Texans on Nov. 15 listed as questionable, he was active and recorded an 85 percent snap share in the contest.

irReserve.name: Raheim Sanders
factors: On Injured Reserve — 21-day practice window not yet opened
irReserve.beatComment: Cleveland elected to open Sanders' practice window following their Week 11 bye, giving the team up to 21 days to evaluate him for a return to the 53-man roster. Before landing on IR on Oct. 13 due to a hip issue, Sanders carried nine times for 43 yards and added 11 receptions for 74 yards on 12 targets over five contests. He'll likely slot in behind Quinshon Judkins and Dylan Sampson on the depth chart at running back once he's activated.

irReserve.name: Michael Burton
factors: Coaching/beat report confirms player will not be activated from IR this week
irReserve.beatComment: Burton was already ruled out for Sunday's game against the Texans due to a calf injury that he picked up against the Saints in Week 9. The injury is severe enough for him to warrant an extended absence, and since he's now on IR, Burton will be required to miss at least four games, so the earliest he can return is Week 15 against the Giants on Sunday, Dec. 20. Since the Browns do not have another fullback on the 53-man roster, the team will likely turn to tight ends Carsen Ryan, Zaire Mitchell-Paden and Blake Whiteheart to provide blocking out of the backfield, per Daniel Oyefusi of ESPN.com.

coachingMatchup.headline: Klint Kubiak & DC Rob Leonard vs. HC Todd Monken, OC Travis Switzer & DC Mike Rutenberg (Road Test)
coachingMatchup.summary: Week 12 two-sided coordinator chess match pitting Las Vegas Raiders's staff (Klint Kubiak, OC Andrew Janocko, DC Rob Leonard) against Cleveland Browns (6-4)—testing both Las Vegas's offensive efficiency and its defensive pass-rush and coverage discipline.
bullets: Pass-Game Efficiency & Coverage Shell Delta: Klint Kubiak and OC Andrew Janocko pair condensed splits with pre-snap jet motion and orbit motion to stress Cleveland Browns's single-high vs. two-high rotations—widening curl/flat defenders to attack the honey-hole between hook/curl linebackers and deep safeties on play-action choice/dagger concepts.

Trench Run-Fit & Two-Way Leverage: Against Cleveland Browns's pin-and-pull, counter, and duo runs targeting the A- and B-gaps, DC Rob Leonard balances four-man pressure with disguised Quarters and Cover 6 split-safety rotations on early downs and in the red zone.

Money-Down & Red-Zone Execution: Third-down conversion discipline and red-zone touchdown rate govern whether Las Vegas sustains multi-play scoring drives or yields momentum to Cleveland Browns's pass rush and coverage disguises.
Tempo, Turnovers & Venue Leverage: Road Test situational play-calling, penalty margin, and turnover differential provide the clearest late-game swing factors for both coaching staffs.

keyMatchupsMatrix.unitMatchup: Fernando Mendoza, Michael Mayer & Tre Tucker vs. CB Denzel Ward & LB Easton Mascarenas-Arnold
keyMatchupsMatrix.statComparison: LV: #11 Pass Off (242.0 yds) · #16 Off. Scoring (+0.48) | CLE: #13 Pass Def (-0.19)
keyMatchupsMatrix.tacticalDetail: Fernando Mendoza, Michael Mayer & Tre Tucker attack the intermediate seams and middle-of-the-field leverage windows against Cleveland Browns's #13 pass defense (-0.19). Winning early-down timing throws keeps Las Vegas's offense ahead of the chains and punishes disguised single-high rotations.
keyMatchupsMatrix.filmTell: Watch Fernando Mendoza (#15) scanning Browns's deep safeties at the snap—when LB Easton Mascarenas-Arnold widens to take away the crossers, the intermediate seam opens immediately for Michael Mayer (#87).

keyMatchupsMatrix.unitMatchup: Maxx Crosby, Kwity Paye & Tonka Hemingway vs. QB Deshaun Watson & OT Spencer Fano
keyMatchupsMatrix.statComparison: LV: #16 Def Sacks (2.3/gm) | CLE: #16 Pass Protection (6.5%)
keyMatchupsMatrix.tacticalDetail: Maxx Crosby, Kwity Paye & Tonka Hemingway lead Las Vegas's #16 NFL pass rush (2.3/gm) against Cleveland Browns's #16 pass-protection unit (6.5%). Collapsing the interior pocket without sending extra blitzers lets Raiders keep seven defenders in coverage.
keyMatchupsMatrix.filmTell: On 3rd-and-6+, watch whether Maxx Crosby (#98) draw chip help from Browns's tight ends or backs—creating 1-on-1 rush lanes inside for Kwity Paye (#95).

keyMatchupsMatrix.unitMatchup: Jeremy Chinn, Nakobe Dean & Quay Walker vs. WR KC Concepcion & QB Deshaun Watson
keyMatchupsMatrix.statComparison: LV: #29 Pass Def (+5.32) | CLE: #18 Pass Off (217.4 yds)
keyMatchupsMatrix.tacticalDetail: Jeremy Chinn, Nakobe Dean & Quay Walker anchor Las Vegas's #29 pass defense (+5.32) against WR KC Concepcion and Cleveland Browns's #18 passing attack (217.4 yds). Limiting explosive 20+ yard chunk plays forces Browns into sustained red-zone drives.
keyMatchupsMatrix.filmTell: Track Jeremy Chinn (#11) at the top of routes against WR KC Concepcion: press-bail alignment with safety help over the top takes away QB Deshaun Watson's preferred isolation shots.

keyMatchupsMatrix.unitMatchup: Ashton Jeanty & Connor Heyward vs. Browns Front Seven & LB Easton Mascarenas-Arnold
keyMatchupsMatrix.statComparison: LV: #31 Rush Off (77.3 yds) | CLE: #23 Rush Def (-0.06)
keyMatchupsMatrix.tacticalDetail: Ashton Jeanty & Connor Heyward test Cleveland Browns's #23 run defense (-0.06) with horizontal stretch and interior cutback lanes. Generating 4.5+ yards on first down unlocks play-action explosives and neutralizes Browns's pass-rush packages.
keyMatchupsMatrix.filmTell: Watch whether Browns's linebackers over-pursue motion to the perimeter—opening decisive backside B-gap cutback lanes for Ashton Jeanty (#2).

keyMatchupsMatrix.unitMatchup: Kolton Miller, Tyler Linderbaum & Spencer Burford vs. DE Isaiah McGuire & Browns Simulated Pressures
keyMatchupsMatrix.statComparison: LV: #16 Pass Protection (6.0%) | CLE: #16 Def Sacks (2.4/gm)
keyMatchupsMatrix.tacticalDetail: Kolton Miller, Tyler Linderbaum & Spencer Burford protect Fernando Mendoza (#16 protection at 6.0%) against DE Isaiah McGuire and Cleveland Browns's #16 pass rush (2.4/gm). Passing off interior twists and simulated blitzes cleanly determines late-down conversion efficiency.
keyMatchupsMatrix.filmTell: Watch Kolton Miller (#74) on obvious passing downs—if DE Isaiah McGuire cannot win clean around the arc, Browns must dial up interior stunts that stress Tyler Linderbaum (#65).
